title: View a text file page by page using more
summary: Open a text file in the terminal and read it one screen at a time. You can scroll down, search for text, and quit when done.

aliases.text: read text file page by page

steps.explain: Open the specified file in the 'more' viewer. The file content will be displayed one screen at a time.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the text file you want to view

steps.expect: The first screen of the file is displayed. At the bottom, you might see a percentage or '--More--' prompt.

steps.explain: Press the Space bar to advance to the next page of the file.
steps.expect: The next screen of text appears.

steps.explain: Type / followed by the text you want to find, then press Enter. Press n to jump to the next match.

placeholders.name: SEARCH_TERM
placeholders.description: The text string you are searching for

steps.expect: The viewer jumps to the first occurrence of the search term.

steps.explain: Press q to exit the viewer and return to the command prompt.
